_templates.inherit_hint_empty: Leave empty to inherit. Currently inherited: {inherited} from {source}.
_templates.features_description: Choose what Roller Shutter Suite takes care of in the whole house. Further pages follow only for what you turn on here.
_templates.features_description_inheriting: Choose what Roller Shutter Suite takes care of here. With "Inherit", the choice of the house or the group applies; the list shows what that is at the moment. Further pages follow only for what is turned on.
_templates.expert_description: The defaults suit most homes. Change them only if you have a reason to.

_templates.fault_title: A setting of {level} cannot be used

fault_problems.unreadable: The saved setting "{key}" cannot be read.
fault_problems.none_not_allowed: The setting "{key}" is saved as "None", but it always needs a value.
fault_problems.invalid: The saved setting "{key}" can be read, but it is not allowed.
fault_problems.not_inheritable: The setting "{key}" can only be made for a single window, but it is saved here. It has no effect here.
fault_problems.unknown_setting: This version of Roller Shutter Suite does not know the saved setting "{key}"; perhaps a newer version saved it. It is ignored.
fault_problems.level_unreadable: The saved settings cannot be read at all.
fault_problems.other: Something is wrong with the saved setting "{key}", and this version of Roller Shutter Suite cannot say more precisely what.

_templates.fault_consequence: Until this is repaired, settings that protect people or hardware or limit movements keep working: they use the same setting of the group or the house instead, and where neither has one, a cautious choice that may hold movements back more than usual. Comfort movements that depend on this setting, such as those of the daily routine, are suspended for the windows concerned, so that no shutter moves unexpectedly.

fault_repairs.global: To repair this, open Roller Shutter Suite, choose "Reconfigure" and save the settings of the house.
fault_repairs.group: To repair this, open the group, check its settings and save it, or delete the group.
fault_repairs.window: To repair this, open the window, check its settings and save it, or delete the window.

user.title: Set up Roller Shutter Suite
user.description: Do you want to set up Roller Shutter Suite? On the next pages you choose the settings for the whole house. Groups and windows inherit them until you override them there.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The settings of the house were saved.

basics.title: Group
basics.description: A group lets several windows share their settings, for example all windows on one side of the house or on one floor.

abort.subentry_removed: The group was deleted while this form was open. Nothing was saved.

basics.title: Window
basics.description: Choose the cover of this window. If several shutters always move together, such as two side by side, choose all their covers or their cover group.

data_description.covers: A cover can belong to one window only.
data_description.group_id: The window inherits the settings of this group. Leave empty to inherit the settings of the house instead.

members.title: Members of the cover group
members.description:
{groups} is a cover group. A cover group only reports an average position of its covers, so this window uses the individual covers instead:

{members}

degraded.title: Covers that only open and close
degraded.description:
These covers cannot be moved to a position, or do not report one: {covers}

You can still use them. They are only ever opened or closed fully, never moved to a position in between.

error.group_removed: The group you chose was deleted while this form was open. Choose another group, or save without one; the window then inherits the settings of the house.
error.cover_in_use: {cover} already belongs to the window "{window}". A cover can belong to one window only.

abort.subentry_removed: The window was deleted while this form was open. Nothing was saved.

window_covers_unreadable.title: Window "{window}" is not set up
window_covers_unreadable.description: The saved covers of the window "{window}" cannot be read, so Roller Shutter Suite does not take care of this window at all. All other windows work as usual. To repair this, open the window, choose its covers again and save it, or delete the window.

group_missing.title: The group of window "{window}" no longer exists
group_missing.description: The window "{window}" belonged to a group that was deleted. Until you open the window and save it, with another group or without one, it inherits the settings of the house.

group_reference_unreadable.title: The group of window "{window}" cannot be read
group_reference_unreadable.description: The saved group of the window "{window}" cannot be read. Settings that protect people or hardware or limit movements use the settings of the house instead. The comfort movements of this window are suspended, because it is not known what the group would have set. To repair this, open the window, choose its group again and save it.

dry_run_unreadable.title: Dry-run of window "{window}" cannot be read
dry_run_unreadable.description: The saved settings do not show whether the window "{window}" is in dry-run. It is treated as being in dry-run, so it does not move. To repair this, open the window and save it.

option_unavailable.title: Window "{window}" cannot use the setting "{key}"
option_unavailable.description: The window "{window}" overrides the setting "{key}", but these covers cannot do what it needs: {covers}. The setting stays saved and applies again as soon as the covers can do it.

setting_combination.title: Saved settings contradict each other
setting_combination.description: Each of these saved settings is fine on its own, but together they are not allowed: {settings}. The name in brackets says where each one is saved. Comfort movements that depend on them are suspended for the windows concerned; settings that protect people or hardware or limit movements keep working. To repair this, change one of the settings and save.

rule_without_keys.title: Saved settings were refused for an unknown reason
rule_without_keys.description: The settings of at least one window were refused as a whole, and Roller Shutter Suite could not tell which settings are the cause. This is an error in the integration, not in your settings. Settings that protect people or hardware or limit movements keep working; comfort movements are suspended. Please report it to the author of the integration.

common.logbook_dry_run_no_target: dry-run, nothing moved: it would have moved. Reason: {cause}.
common.logbook_held_back: movement to {target} % held back: {held}. Reason for the movement: {cause}.
common.logbook_held_back_no_target: movement held back: {held}. Reason for the movement: {cause}.
